treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Singapore and the Government of the People's Republic of China for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income (2007, as amended by Protocols 2009 and 2010, and modified by the MLI)
eif_quote: Date of Conclusion: 11 July 2007 / Entry into Force: 18 September 2007 / Effective Date: 1 January 2008 | Art. 28(2)(a): "in China: in respect of income derived during the taxable years beginning on or after the first day of January next following that in which this Agreement enters into force."
source_title: IRAS: Singapore-China DTA (ratified)(MLI)(1 Sep 2022) - consolidated English text with 2nd/3rd Protocols and MLI Annex A

rates.quote: 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest in all other cases.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.basis: MLI art. 7(1) (inserted as Article 27A per IRAS synthesised text)
ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of this Agreement, a benefit under this Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Agreement.

notes: Interest: Art. 11(2)(a) - 7% cap where the interest is received by any bank or financial institution (recipient-type condition, not modelled as a tier); Art. 11(3) (as replaced by 2nd Protocol 2009) exempts interest beneficially owned by the Governments, central banks and listed state financial institutions. Royalties: Protocol para. 3 - equipment royalties taxed on 60% of gross (effective 6%). Dividends: Art. 10(6) main-purpose clause. MLI Art. 8 (365-day holding) does NOT apply: Singapore reserved Art. 8 entirely under Art. 8(3)(a). MLI effective for WHT from 2023-01-01 (IRAS Annex A para. 7; map.json). valid_from 2008-01-01 is the China-side effective date (Art. 28(2)(a)); for Singapore the Agreement applies from YA 2009 (Art. 28(2)(b)) - Singapore levies no WHT on dividends. The 2007 Agreement replaced the 1986 Agreement. 3rd Protocol 2010 concerns exchange of information only.
